title: Binance Convert Enhances Trading With Alpha Token Support
text: This is a general announcement and marketing communication. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, We are thrilled to introduce Alpha Token support on Binance Convert - bringing users an effortless and seamless gateway to access the latest Web3 innovations. With Binance Convert optimized for simplicity, both seasoned and new users can now effortlessly trade Alpha tokens. With real-time data synchronization, instant trade quotes, and a simplified trading process, users can skip the complexities of blockchain navigation and enjoy direct, reliable access to emerging tokens. Key Highlights of Alpha Token Support on Binance Convert  Real-time Alpha Token Data Sync:  Continuously updated Alpha token information, including trading limits and prices, providing users with the latest market data for better decision-making. Instant Quotation:  Fast, transparent trade quotes with automatic refreshes to help enhance clarity in transactions, ensuring users always know what to expect. Convenient and Accessible:  With a simple setup and minimal capital requirements, users can now explore Alpha tokens easily. How to Trade Alpha tokens on Binance Convert Step 1: Login to your Binance account and click  [Trade]  -  [Convert] . Step 2: Select  [Instant]  mode. Step 3: Select the Alpha token pairs and the amount that you would like to convert. Step 4: Click  [Preview] . Step 5: Confirm the order details and complete identity verification to authorize the trade. Start your Alpha journey with Convert today! The inclusion of a digital asset as a Binance Alpha asset does not in any way imply, directly or indirectly, that such digital assets will be listed on Binance Exchange in the future.  As digital asset prices can be volatile, the value of any investment that you make in Binance Alpha Assets may go down or up and you may lose all or part of the value of the amount that you invest. Converting Alpha digital assets to digital assets listed on the Binance Exchange are deemed as Convert Instant Orders subject to the Convert Terms and the Binance Alpha Warning.
